tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by query and optional category.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed product information by product ID.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Check stock quantity and availability for a product.

tools.name: get_product_recommendations
tools.description: Recommend products based on customer context.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare multiple products side by side.

tools.name: get_return_policy
tools.description: Retrieve product-specific or store-wide return policy information.

tools.name: create_product
tools.input_summary: product_id, name, category, price, description, specifications, stock_quantity
tools.description: Create a new product in the catalog.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Modify product attributes such as name, description, specs, or category.

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: Soft delete a product by marking it discontinued.

tools.name: update_inventory
tools.description: Adjust stock quantities and optional restock dates.

tools.name: update_pricing
tools.input_summary: product_id, new_price, optional sale_price, optional sale_end_date
tools.description: Change regular pricing and optional sale pricing.
